# Metadata extraction

# Audio Transcription

## Google Auto generated captions:

yt-dlp --write-auto-subs --sub-lang bn --skip-download "FNpaffTRcwg"


yt-dlp --write-auto-subs --sub-lang bn --convert-subs srt --skip-download "FNpaffTRcwg"

yt-dlp --write-auto-subs --sub-lang bn --convert-subs srt --skip-download "iQGd-XYFfoc"

# Workflow

so, from each video
    - audio
    - metadata like doctor info, date, disease / medical condition name, video-id, video desc, 
    - nicelly formatted (like json) text transcription 
    - if possible, also QA pairs like for this patient query, this reply
    - or multi turn conversation
